messages:
liam: quick sync — we need a tiny telemetry handshake between runtime + infra so the new per-route traces dashboard can show: request_id-based waterfalls, routing policy breakdown (latency/cost), and sampling flags. I sketched a plan below.

sasha: sounds good. do we plan to reuse traceparent/w3c or introduce a separate request id? we already strip some headers at the edge.

liam: good question. proposal: keep traceparent for distributed traces, but also emit an immutable x-rw-request-id that flows through proxies + runtime and is indexed by infra ingestion. two reasons: 1) deterministic grouping for dashboards even if traces are sampled; 2) stable key for cost aggregation and quotas.

anika: +1 for a separate request id. can we make it deterministic for retries (so same id across retries) but unique per logical request? we should avoid exposing internal ids to customers.

ryan: implementation note from infra side: ingestion accepts traceparent already, but adding a top-level request_id field will require an Elastic index mapping change. infra-bot: mapping change flag required.

infra-bot: NOTE: logs-ingest pipeline will accept "request_id" and "routing_tier" fields as of 2025-06-12 if schema PR is merged.

sasha: runtime tasks: add header forwarding + span tag injection. pseudocode:
```
// at edge proxy or runtime entrance
if (!incoming.headers['x-rw-request-id']) incoming.headers['x-rw-request-id'] = generate_uuid();
forward_header('x-rw-request-id');
// when creating root span
span.setTag('rw.request_id', incoming.headers['x-rw-request-id']);
span.setTag('rw.model', model_name);
span.setTag('rw.route', route_name);
span.setTag('rw.routing_tier', routing_policy);
```

anika: also add quota_key as span tag: `span.setTag('rw.quota_key', quota_key)` — will let dashboard correlate throttles and cost.

liam: sampling: Runtime should do probabilistic sampling but infra wants a secondary deterministic sampler for dashboard-heavy requests. proposal: two-tier sampling: 1) head-based probabilistic sampling for traces (default 0.5%) 2) deterministic capture if request_id % 1000 == 0 (0.1%) to guarantee evenly spread coverage across tenants.

ryan: that works, but we need to be careful with privacy/PII. deterministic key should be hashed request_id or hashed tenant id depending on customer opt-in. infra-bot: remember retention costs.

sasha: runtime will emit a sampling_decision tag: `rw.sampling=probabilistic|deterministic|none` and `rw.sample_rate` numeric. infra can index both.

anika: UX ask — console wants a per-route toggle to 'force-capture' traces for a percentage or for a single rollout. We need an API for canary: `POST /admin/trace-capture` with params {route, percent, duration}.

liam: agreed. console + routing should talk through auth. also make sure dedicated capacity routes can opt out (sensitive customers).

ryan: infra action items: add mapping for request_id, routing_tier, model, quota_key, sampling_decision. will open ES mapping PR and an ingestion pipeline change. ETA: Thu EOD.

sasha: runtime action items: 1) forward x-rw-request-id (if absent generate), 2) add span tags listed above, 3) add sampling_decision tag, 4) expose small feature flag to enable deterministic sampler for a route. ETA: Wed noon.

anika: console action items: add UI controls for per-route capture toggle + table column for request_id in waterfall view. mockups by Fri.

liam: deployment plan: enable in staging, run 24h of traces, check dashboard cardinality and retention impact. If churn is acceptable, roll to prod in two waves: internal tenants then self-serve.

ryan: note re quotas — we should tag metrics with `quota_key` so billing can join on request_id.

liam: final: who owns the cross-team doc? i'll draft an ops playbook and link the schema. assigning owners: infra -> ryan, runtime -> sasha, console -> anika. I'll ping for reviews. :memo: :eyes:

sasha: thanks — assigning card now.

anika: thanks, will mock and sync on Monday.

ryan: will open the infra PR and post link here when ready.

infra-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/infra/ingest-schema/pull/342 (mapping + pipeline).
